name: @fidscript/webmail
description: A self-hosted webmail and mail-management platform on Stalwart. Stalwart is the mail server; this application is the complete user-facing experience: dashboard, inbox, compose, folders, spam, contacts, settings, admin account and domain management, and a mail-health & deliverability module. Runs standalone on any VPS; FIDScript integration is one deployment mode, not a dependency.
